answer: 2023–24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed; 1,579 responses were recorded, stated as about 72%. The report also recalculated participation after excluding 385 LEAs that said they did not offer TK: 1,579 responses among the remaining 1,823 LEAs, stated as 87%. 2024–25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed; 952 responses were recorded, stated as about 65%. The report additionally says that 926 of the remaining LEAs (95%) indicated they had at least one TK program; it does not label that 95% as the survey response rate. Thus, from 2023–24 to 2024–25, the survey covered 744 fewer LEAs, recorded 627 fewer responses, and the stated overall response rate fell by about 7 percentage points (72% to 65%).
